num_sites: <int> Number of candidate venue sites where events may be held.
num_customers: <int> Number of customer locations representing nearby population centers.
num_periods: <int> Number of time periods in the planning horizon.

parameters.T: <int> Number of time periods in the planning horizon.
parameters.delta: <int> Maximum number of events that may be held in any window of delta-plus-one consecutive periods.
parameters.epsilon: <int> Number of periods before and after a given period considered when computing competitive interactions among events.
parameters.L: <float> Maximum travel distance allowed in any single period.
parameters.c: <float> Cost per unit distance traveled between sites.
parameters.q: <float> Distance decay exponent controlling how quickly customer attraction diminishes with distance.
parameters.weekly_attraction_cycle: <list[float], length 7> Relative attractiveness factor for each day of the week from Monday to Sunday, cycling over periods.
parameters.avg_businesses_customers: <float> Average number of businesses across all customer locations, used to normalize self-attraction values.
parameters.avg_businesses_sites: <float> Average number of businesses across all venue sites, used to normalize site attraction values.

sites.id: <int> Unique identifier for this venue site (1-indexed).
sites.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of the venue site in miles.
sites.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of the venue site in miles.
sites.capacity: <int> Maximum number of attendees the venue can accommodate at any single event.
sites.num_businesses: <int> Number of businesses near the venue site, used to compute site attraction.
sites.revenue_per_customer: <int> Revenue earned per customer attending an event at this site.
sites.fixed_cost: <int> Fixed cost incurred each time an event is held at this site.
sites.max_events: <int> Maximum number of events that may be held at this site over the entire planning horizon.

customers.id: <int> Unique identifier for this customer location (1-indexed).
customers.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of the customer location in miles.
customers.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of the customer location in miles.
customers.population: <int> Number of potential attendees residing at this customer location.
customers.num_businesses: <int> Number of businesses at this customer location, used to compute self-attraction.

site_to_site_distances: <dict, key: '{from_site}_{to_site}'> Travel distance between each pair of venue sites, including the dummy starting site 0 which has zero distance to all venues.
customer_to_site_distances: <dict, key: '{customer}_{site}'> Distance from each customer location to each venue site.
